batch: APAAR Student Register, Problem scene B-roll
style_signature: flat bold color field, mixed black-and-white halftone cut-outs and colored cardstock accents, crisp cut edges, cream keylines, soft paper shadows, editorial paper collage
avoid: typography, readable letters, numerals, logos, watermark, UI, subtitles, glossy 3D, photoreal environment

items.line: Excess admissions hide inside those numbers.
items.visual_metaphor: one large blank cream card stands like a shield; behind it halftone student figures stack until they spill over its top edge past a saffron limit strip
items.assembly: limit strip -> card -> figures stack -> overflow peeks above

items.line: The same student can appear at two colleges at once.
items.visual_metaphor: one halftone student portrait torn down the middle; each half pinned under a different college facade; a red thread joins the halves
items.assembly: two facades -> torn halves slide under -> pins -> thread tightens

items.line: When an employer asks if a degree is real, the answer is a letter and a long wait.
items.visual_metaphor: a halftone hand offers a sealed envelope towards a desk while a tall envelope stack rises beside it under a paper clock
items.assembly: clock -> envelope stack rises -> hand slides in -> seal stamps

items.visual_metaphor: scattered paper pieces (student cut-outs, envelopes, facades) file into neat rows inside one large cream ledger page with a navy binding and a saffron tab
items.assembly: binding -> page -> rows file in -> tab clicks into place
